heading: Tell us what you're making.

body.html: We take on a handful of projects a year. The best first message is short: what the product does, who it is for, and the moment in it that does not feel right yet.

prompts: What are you building, and for whom?
What feels wrong about it today?
When does it need to be live?
Who on your side will we work with?
thanks: Thank you, it's with us. We read every message and reply within two working days, usually with questions.
